question: Can the five fish-name labels in the AIIB EIA’s February 2020 Naic fisher interview context be reconciled to current Catalog of Fishes names without treating this as validation of fish identification or capture locality?

sources.context: February 2020 interviews with fisherfolk in Timalan Balsahan and Timalan Concepcion; fishing grounds described around Corregidor and Caballo Islands.
sources.limits: The catch labels are reported interview context, not voucher-backed specimen identifications. No fish-specific coordinates or capture station are provided.

sources.title: Eschmeyer’s Catalog of Fishes
sources.homepageVersion: Catalog site reported an online version updated 20 October 2026; individual entry update labels are recorded where visible.
sources.limits: Catalog status resolves nomenclature only; it cannot validate the EIA interview’s fish identifications or where each fish was captured.

nameCrosswalk.disposition: Likely report spelling error; preserve the EIA spelling as source data and use this only as a nomenclatural candidate. No specimen or interview identification is validated.

separationRules: The crosswalk is limited to the five fish names in the offshore interview catch context; the two crab labels are not taxonomically reviewed here.

nextAction: Resolve species-specific capture grounds, field identification support and item-specific EIA reuse terms before considering any marine-area occurrence assertion. Keep this interview list unassigned and separate from Timalan River.
